name: Brunnmigi
body:
BRUNNMIGI
CR 7

A naked bipedal man with foxlike features stands atop a well. The sound of liquid hitting the well’s water corresponds with the man’s stream of urine.

XP 3,200
CN Small fey
Init +9; Senses low-light vision; Perception +15

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 16, flat-footed 15 (+5 Dex, +4 natural, +1 size)
hp 71 (11d6+33)
Fort +8, Ref +12, Will +8
DR 5/cold iron and piercing; SR 18
Weaknesses vulnerability to fire

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk dagger +11 (1d3+5/19-20), da4gger +11 (1d3+5/19-20)
Special Attacks extended befoulment, premonitory curse
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 11th; concentration +13)

At will—putrefy food and drink (DC 12)

STATISTICS

Str 11, Dex 20, Con 17, Int 11, Wis 12, Cha 14
Base Atk +5; CMB +4; CMD 19
Feats Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Taunt, Two-weapon Fighting, Weapon Finesse, Weapon Focus (dagger)
Skills Acrobatics +19, Bluff +16, Escape Artist +19, Knowledge (nature) +14, Perception +15, Stealth +23
SQ change shape (fey, hybrid, and fox; polymorph)
Gear dagger, masterwork dagger

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Extended Befoulment (Su)

Three times per day, a brunnmigi can spend 1 minute ruining a source of water for 24 hours. The brunnmigi chooses to inflict disease or cause the water to be useless when it befouls the water source. Creatures drinking from diseased water must succeed at a DC 18 Fortitude save or be affected by a disease of the brunnmigi’s choice listed in contagion.

Creatures drinking unusable water believe they have quenched their thirst but the water does not hydrate them; plants within 100 feet of the unusable water eventually wither and die if the brunnmigi continues to affect the same water source. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Premonitory Curse (Su)

As an immediate action when attacked with a weapon that bypasses its damage resistance or with fire, the brunnmigi foretells doom for the attacker, who must make a DC 17 Will save. If the creature fails its save, at one time within the next 24 hours, the GM can choose to make a creature’s attack roll or saving throw a natural 1, if it is related to the premonition.

The brunnmigi can only have one creature cursed at a time. If it curses another creature, the curse immediately ends for the previous creature. The save DC is Charisma-based.

ECOLOGY

Environment any temperate
Organization solitary
Treasure standard (masterwork dagger, dagger, and other treasure)

Brunnmigi translates as “pees in wells,” which describes how the fey creature destroys life-giving water. Brunnmigis might defile water supplies as revenge for some perceived slight, but they usually do so to sow chaos, death, and destruction for their own entertainment.

Since most of their activity causes them to cross paths with people, brunnmigis try to keep a low profile. They creep into villages to befoul wells at night or shapeshift into a seemingly innocuous fox. The latter option doesn’t serve them well for long, as suspicious villagers associate foxes with the water’s pollution. This always results in a fox culling and forces additional circumspection from the brunnmigis. If brunnmigis can’t target wells or other communal sources of water, they search for streams or ponds that feed cultivated areas.

In rare physical confrontations, brunnmigis rely on their daggers if in fey or hybrid form, or their fangs and claws in fox form. They enjoy supernatural protection from physical damage and spellcasting, but when confronted by weaponry or fire that bypasses their protection, they levy curses against foes wielding such weapons or fire.

They couch these curses in vague prophetic terms (“your prowess will fail you when you need it most”), which causes those who resist the curses to fear for the future and plead with the brunnmigis to change their predictions.
